items.title: Amazon Tops $3T, Meta Rallies 7% as AI Hyperscalers Ride Earnings Momentum

items.title: The ‘Nvidia Tax’: Alphabet Mitigates It Better Than Amazon or Any Other Mag 7 Stock
items.summary: Every hyperscaler pays NVIDIA a massive toll to compete at the AI frontier, but one Mag 7 giant has quietly built an escape route that the others lack. The answer comes down to who actually owns the silicon running their biggest bets.

items.title: How the S&P 500 Survives a Chip Meltdown Without Falling Into a Bear Market
items.summary: Chip stocks have taken it on the chin lately, but worries about the AI trade don’t have to bring down the entire market.  The S&P 500’s information technology and communications sectors fell 15% from June 1 through July 29, when the Federal Reserve announced it was holding the fed-funds rate steady, strategist Jim Paulsen wrote Monday on Substack.  The overall S&P 500 ended up down less than 4%.
